```{r}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Set working directory (update as needed)
setwd("~/Desktop/Aiptasia")

# File names and treatments
file_names <- c("symNit_stress.txt", "symHnit_stress.txt", "symHeat_stress.txt", 
                "apoNit_stress.txt", "apoHnit_stress.txt", "apoHeat_stress.txt")
treatment_names <- c("symNit", "symHnit", "symHeat", "apoNit", "apoHnit", "apoHeat")

# Read & merge DGE files
dfs <- lapply(seq_along(file_names), function(i) {
  df <- read.delim(file_names[i], header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[, c("Gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")]
  colnames(df)[2:3] <- paste0(c("log2FC_", "padj_"), treatment_names[i])
  df
})
merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "Gene"), dfs)

# Read genes of interest and filter
cell_cycle_genes <- read.csv("genes_in_moduleof_interest/cell_cycle_dge.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gene_ids <- cell_cycle_genes$Gene
merged_filtered <- merged %>% filter(Gene %in% gene_ids)
merged_filtered <- merged_filtered[match(gene_ids, merged_filtered$Gene), ]
rownames(merged_filtered) <- cell_cycle_genes$Gene_name

# Extract log2FC and padj matrices
log2fc_cols <- grep("^log2FC_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
padj_cols <- grep("^padj_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
log2fc_mat <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, log2fc_cols])
padj_mat   <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, padj_cols])

# Prepare matrix for display: numbers only for padj < 0.05
numbers_to_display <- ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05 & !is.na(log2fc_mat), round(log2fc_mat, 2), "")

# Relabel columns for clarity and build annotation data frame
treatment_labels <- gsub("^log2FC_", "", colnames(log2fc_mat))
treatment_labels <- gsub("sym", "Symbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("apo", "Aposymbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("Hnit", "Heat+Nitrate", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("heat", "Heat", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("nit", "Nitrate", treatment_labels)
colnames(log2fc_mat) <- treatment_labels
colnames(numbers_to_display) <- treatment_labels

col_ann <- data.frame(
  state = ifelse(grepl("^Aposymbiotic", colnames(log2fc_mat)), "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"),
  Treatment = gsub(".*_(.*)$", "\\1", colnames(log2fc_mat)),
  row.names = colnames(log2fc_mat)
)
col_ann$Treatment[col_ann$Treatment == "Nit"] <- "Nitrate"  # Fix abbreviation

# Define colors for annotations
ann_colors <- list(
  state = c(Symbiotic = "#8B4513", Aposymbiotic = "gray40"),
  Treatment = c(Nitrate = "#556B2F", Heat = "coral1", `Heat+Nitrate` = "#D65278")
)

# Order: Aposymbiotic first, then Symbiotic; within each, Nit, Heat, Heat+Nit
desired_treatment_order <- c("Nitrate", "Heat", "Heat+Nitrate")
ordered_idx <- order(
  factor(col_ann$state, levels = c("Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic")),
  factor(col_ann$Treatment, levels = desired_treatment_order)
)
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, ordered_idx]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, ordered_idx]
col_ann <- col_ann[ordered_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Heatmap color scale and breaks
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100)
breaks <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 101)

# Plot the heatmap (remove y-axis/row labels)
pdf("cell_cycle_heatmap1.pdf", height = 1.5, width = 3.9)
pheatmap(
  log2fc_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  color = rev(col),
  breaks = breaks,
  na_col = "white",
  display_numbers = numbers_to_display,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  fontsize_number = 4,
  number_color = "white",
  annotation_col = col_ann,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  labels_col = NA,
  border_color      = "black"
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# --- Read rlog counts ---
rlog_counts <- read.csv("AIP_rlog_transformed_counts.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(rlog_counts) <- rlog_counts$Gene
rlog_counts$Gene <- NULL
rlog_mat <- as.matrix(rlog_counts)

# --- Read genes of interest ---
cell_cycle_genes <- read.csv("genes_in_moduleof_interest/cell_cycle_dge.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gene_ids <- cell_cycle_genes$Gene

# --- Filter + reorder to match your gene list, rename rows ---
expr_filtered <- rlog_mat[rownames(rlog_mat) %in% gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]
expr_filtered <- expr_filtered[match(gene_ids, rownames(expr_filtered)), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(expr_filtered) <- cell_cycle_genes$Gene_name

# --- Read sample metadata/coding key ---
sample_meta <- read.csv("sample_name_ALL_fin_2025.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Inspect it first:
# str(sample_meta)
# head(sample_meta)

# ASSUMPTION (adjust once file is seen): sample_meta has columns like
#   sample_id, state (Aposymbiotic/Symbiotic), Treatment (Control/Nitrate/Heat/Heat+Nitrate)

# Make sure sample_meta rows are ordered/matched to expr_filtered columns
sample_meta <- sample_meta[match(colnames(expr_filtered), sample_meta$sample), ]

col_ann_full <- data.frame(
  state = sample_meta$state,
  Treatment = sample_meta$Treatment_1,
  row.names = sample_meta$sample
)

# --- Annotation colors ---
ann_colors <- list(
  Treatment = c(Control = "#4292c6", Nitrate = "#556B2F", Heat = "coral1", `Heat+Nitrate` = "#D65278")
)

desired_treatment_order <- c("Control", "Nitrate", "Heat", "Heat+Nitrate")
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(250)

# --- Function to subset, order, and plot one state (Apo or Sym) ---
plot_state_heatmap <- function(state_label, expr_mat, ann_full, out_file) {
  keep <- rownames(ann_full)[ann_full$state == state_label]
  expr_sub <- expr_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  ann_sub <- ann_full[keep, "Treatment", drop = FALSE]

  ordered_idx <- order(factor(ann_sub$Treatment, levels = desired_treatment_order))
  expr_sub <- expr_sub[, ordered_idx]
  ann_sub <- ann_sub[ordered_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  pdf(out_file, height = 3, width = 4.5)
  pheatmap(
    expr_sub,
    scale = "row",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = rev(col),
    na_col = "white",
    fontsize_row = 8,
    fontsize_col = 6,
    annotation_col = ann_sub,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    border_color = NA,
    main = state_label
  )
  dev.off()
}

table(col_ann_full$state)  # sanity check before plotting
table(col_ann_full$Treatment)
# --- Generate both heatmaps ---
plot_state_heatmap("Aposymbiotic", expr_filtered, col_ann_full, "cell_cycle_heatmap_apo.pdf")
plot_state_heatmap("Symbiotic",    expr_filtered, col_ann_full, "cell_cycle_heatmap_sym.pdf")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# File names and treatments
file_names <- c("symNit_stress.txt", "symHnit_stress.txt", "symHeat_stress.txt", 
                "apoNit_stress.txt", "apoHnit_stress.txt", "apoHeat_stress.txt")
treatment_names <- c("symNit", "symHnit", "symHeat", "apoNit", "apoHnit", "apoHeat")

# Read & merge DGE files
dfs <- lapply(seq_along(file_names), function(i) {
  df <- read.delim(file_names[i], header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[, c("Gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")]
  colnames(df)[2:3] <- paste0(c("log2FC_", "padj_"), treatment_names[i])
  df
})
merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "Gene"), dfs)

# Read genes of interest and filter
cell_cycle_genes <- read.csv("Symbiosis_genes2.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gene_ids <- cell_cycle_genes$Gene
merged_filtered <- merged %>% filter(Gene %in% gene_ids)
merged_filtered <- merged_filtered[match(gene_ids, merged_filtered$Gene), ]

# Make unique rownames from Gene_name column
rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(cell_cycle_genes$Gene_name)

# Extract log2FC and padj matrices
log2fc_cols <- grep("^log2FC_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
padj_cols <- grep("^padj_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
log2fc_mat <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, log2fc_cols])
padj_mat   <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, padj_cols])

# Prepare numbers to display on heatmap: only log2FC where padj < 0.05, else blank
numbers_to_display <- ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05 & !is.na(log2fc_mat), round(log2fc_mat, 2), "")

# Relabel columns for clarity and build annotation data frame
treatment_labels <- gsub("^log2FC_", "", colnames(log2fc_mat))
treatment_labels <- gsub("sym", "Symbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("apo", "Aposymbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("Hnit", "Heat+Nitrate", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("heat", "Heat", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("nit", "Nitrate", treatment_labels)
colnames(log2fc_mat) <- treatment_labels
colnames(numbers_to_display) <- treatment_labels

col_ann <- data.frame(
  state = ifelse(grepl("^Aposymbiotic", colnames(log2fc_mat)), "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"),
  Treatment = gsub(".*_(.*)$", "\\1", colnames(log2fc_mat)),
  row.names = colnames(log2fc_mat)
)
col_ann$Treatment[col_ann$Treatment == "Nit"] <- "Nitrate"  # Fix abbreviation

# Define colors for annotations
ann_colors <- list(
  state = c(Symbiotic = "#8B4513", Aposymbiotic = "gray40"),
  Treatment = c(Nitrate = "#556B2F", Heat = "coral1", `Heat+Nitrate` = "#D65278")
)

# Order columns: Aposymbiotic first, then Symbiotic; within each, Nitrate, Heat, Heat+Nitrate
desired_treatment_order <- c("Nitrate", "Heat", "Heat+Nitrate")
ordered_idx <- order(
  factor(col_ann$state, levels = c("Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic")),
  factor(col_ann$Treatment, levels = desired_treatment_order)
)
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, ordered_idx]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, ordered_idx]
col_ann <- col_ann[ordered_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Heatmap color scale and breaks
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100)
breaks <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 101)

# Plot the heatmap with gene names as row labels
pdf("symbiosis_heatmap_v3.pdf", height = 1.5, width = 3.9)
pheatmap(
  log2fc_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  color = rev(col),
  breaks = breaks,
  na_col = "white",
  display_numbers = numbers_to_display,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  fontsize_number = 4,
  number_color = "white",
  annotation_col = col_ann,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  labels_col = NULL,   # default column labels shown
  labels_row = NULL,   # default row labels (gene names) shown
  border_color = "black"
)
dev.off()
```


```{r}
#pullout immune related
# File names and treatments
file_names <- c("symNit_stress.txt", "symHnit_stress.txt", "symHeat_stress.txt", 
                "apoNit_stress.txt", "apoHnit_stress.txt", "apoHeat_stress.txt")
treatment_names <- c("symNit", "symHnit", "symHeat", "apoNit", "apoHnit", "apoHeat")

# Read & merge DGE files
dfs <- lapply(seq_along(file_names), function(i) {
  df <- read.delim(file_names[i], header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[, c("Gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")]
  colnames(df)[2:3] <- paste0(c("log2FC_", "padj_"), treatment_names[i])
  df
})
merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "Gene"), dfs)
# Read immune genes of interest and filter/align
immune_genes <- read.csv("genes_in_moduleof_interest/immune_all_brown_module.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gene_ids <- immune_genes$Gene
merged_filtered <- merged %>% filter(Gene %in% gene_ids)
# Align merged_filtered to the order of gene_ids
merged_filtered <- merged_filtered[match(gene_ids, merged_filtered$Gene), ]

# Remove rows where Gene is NA (sometimes introduced by unmatched genes)
merged_filtered <- merged_filtered[!is.na(merged_filtered$Gene), ]

# Assign gene names as rownames, making sure there are no duplicates
rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(immune_genes$Gene_name[match(merged_filtered$Gene, immune_genes$Gene)])


# Extract log2FC and padj matrices
log2fc_cols <- grep("^log2FC_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
padj_cols <- grep("^padj_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
log2fc_mat <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, log2fc_cols])
padj_mat   <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, padj_cols])

# Matrix for display: numbers only for padj < 0.05
numbers_to_display <- ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05 & !is.na(log2fc_mat), round(log2fc_mat, 2), "")

# Relabel columns for clarity and build annotation data frame
treatment_labels <- gsub("^log2FC_", "", colnames(log2fc_mat))
treatment_labels <- gsub("sym", "Symbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("apo", "Aposymbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("Hnit", "Heat+Nitrate", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("heat", "Heat", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("nit", "Nitrate", treatment_labels)
colnames(log2fc_mat) <- treatment_labels
colnames(numbers_to_display) <- treatment_labels

col_ann <- data.frame(
  state = ifelse(grepl("^Aposymbiotic", colnames(log2fc_mat)), "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"),
  Treatment = gsub(".*_(.*)$", "\\1", colnames(log2fc_mat)),
  row.names = colnames(log2fc_mat)
)
col_ann$Treatment[col_ann$Treatment == "Nit"] <- "Nitrate"  # Fix abbreviation

# Define colors for annotations
ann_colors <- list(
  state = c(Symbiotic = "#8B4513", Aposymbiotic = "gray40"),
  Treatment = c(Nitrate = "#556B2F", Heat = "coral1", `Heat+Nitrate` = "#D65278")
)

# Order columns: Aposymbiotic first, then Symbiotic; within each, Nit, Heat, Heat+Nit
desired_treatment_order <- c("Nitrate", "Heat", "Heat+Nitrate")
ordered_idx <- order(
  factor(col_ann$state, levels = c("Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic")),
  factor(col_ann$Treatment, levels = desired_treatment_order)
)
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, ordered_idx]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, ordered_idx]
col_ann <- col_ann[ordered_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Heatmap color scale and breaks
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100)
breaks <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 101)

# Remove columns named NA or that are all NA (just in case)
keep_cols <- !is.na(colnames(log2fc_mat)) & colnames(log2fc_mat) != "" & !apply(log2fc_mat, 2, function(x) all(is.na(x)))
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, keep_cols]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, keep_cols]
col_ann <- col_ann[keep_cols, , drop = FALSE]

 "NFKB1", "TRAF3", "MAP3K7", "TRAF6", "MYD88_TLR", "AP1G1", "JUN", "MAP2K7", "MAP4K4",
 "DDX4", "MALT1", "CSNK1A1", "CSNK1G2", "CSNK1E", "MYC", "MYCBPAP", "mycbp", "CREB1",
"ACVR1", "CUL1", "DNM1L", "RPS6KA5", "BCL3", "CASP7", "IFIH1", "PIN1", "RNF31",
 "TRPM2", "GRB2", "DAXX", "FGFR4", "FGFR2", "FGF7", "FGF20", "FGF18", "MAP3K13",
 "MAP3K2", "MAP3K20", "MAPK7", "MKNK1", "PLA2G4A", "PRKCA", "RASA1", "TAOK1", "Tie",
 "STAT5B", "CALM3"
)
genes_present <- intersect(gene_list, rownames(log2fc_mat))
```

```{r}
# --- Read rlog counts ---
rlog_counts <- read.csv("AIP_rlog_transformed_counts.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(rlog_counts) <- rlog_counts$Gene
rlog_counts$Gene <- NULL
rlog_mat <- as.matrix(rlog_counts)

# --- Read immune module gene list (maps Gene ID <-> Gene_name) ---
immune_genes <- read.csv("genes_in_moduleof_interest/immune_all_brown_module.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- Specific immune genes of interest (gene symbols) ---
gene_list <- c(
  "NFKB1", "TRAF3", "MAP3K7", "TRAF6", "MYD88_TLR", "AP1G1", "JUN", "MAP2K7", "MAP4K4",
  "DDX4", "MALT1", "CSNK1A1", "CSNK1G2", "CSNK1E", "MYC", "MYCBPAP", "mycbp", "CREB1",
  "ACVR1", "CUL1", "DNM1L", "RPS6KA5", "BCL3", "CASP7", "IFIH1", "PIN1", "RNF31",
  "TRPM2", "GRB2", "DAXX", "FGFR4", "FGFR2", "FGF7", "FGF20", "FGF18", "MAP3K13",
  "MAP3K2", "MAP3K20", "MAPK7", "MKNK1", "PLA2G4A", "PRKCA", "RASA1", "TAOK1", "Tie",
  "STAT5B", "CALM3"
)

# --- Restrict module table to just these genes, preserving gene_list order ---
immune_sub <- immune_genes %>% filter(Gene_name %in% gene_list)
immune_sub <- immune_sub[match(gene_list, immune_sub$Gene_name), ]
immune_sub <- immune_sub[!is.na(immune_sub$Gene), ]   # drop any not found in the module file

gene_ids <- immune_sub$Gene

# --- Filter + reorder rlog matrix to match gene_list, rename rows to gene symbols ---
expr_filtered <- rlog_mat[rownames(rlog_mat) %in% gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]
expr_filtered <- expr_filtered[match(gene_ids, rownames(expr_filtered)), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(expr_filtered) <- make.unique(immune_sub$Gene_name[match(rownames(expr_filtered), immune_sub$Gene)])

# --- Read sample metadata/coding key ---
sample_meta <- read.csv("sample_name_ALL_fin_2025.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sample_meta <- sample_meta[match(colnames(expr_filtered), sample_meta$sample), ]

col_ann_full <- data.frame(
  state = sample_meta$state,
  Treatment = sample_meta$Treatment_1,
  row.names = sample_meta$sample
)

# Strip redundant apo_/sym_ prefix from Treatment
col_ann_full$Treatment <- gsub("^apo_|^sym_", "", col_ann_full$Treatment)

# Relabel to full display names
col_ann_full$Treatment <- recode(col_ann_full$Treatment,
  "Cont" = "Control",
  "Nit"  = "Nitrate",
  "Heat" = "Heat",
  "Hnit" = "Heat+Nitrate"
)

# --- Annotation colors ---
ann_colors <- list(
  Treatment = c(Control = "#4292c6", Nitrate = "#556B2F", Heat = "coral1", `Heat+Nitrate` = "#D65278")
)

desired_treatment_order <- c("Control", "Nitrate", "Heat", "Heat+Nitrate")
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(250)

# --- Function to subset, order, and plot one state (Apo or Sym) ---
plot_state_heatmap <- function(state_label, expr_mat, ann_full, out_file) {
  keep <- rownames(ann_full)[ann_full$state == state_label]
  expr_sub <- expr_mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  ann_sub <- ann_full[keep, "Treatment", drop = FALSE]

  ordered_idx <- order(factor(ann_sub$Treatment, levels = desired_treatment_order))
  expr_sub <- expr_sub[, ordered_idx]
  ann_sub <- ann_sub[ordered_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  pdf(out_file, height = 3, width = 4.5)
  pheatmap(
    expr_sub,
    scale = "row",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = rev(col),
    na_col = "white",
    fontsize_row = 8,
    fontsize_col = 6,
    annotation_col = ann_sub,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    border_color = NA,
    main = state_label
  )
  dev.off()
}

table(col_ann_full$state)      # sanity check
table(col_ann_full$Treatment)  # sanity check

# --- Generate both heatmaps ---
plot_state_heatmap("Aposymbiotic", expr_filtered, col_ann_full, "immune_heatmap_apo.pdf")
plot_state_heatmap("Symbiotic",    expr_filtered, col_ann_full, "immune_heatmap_sym.pdf")
```

```{r}
# Read your gene list (with both Gene and Gene_name columns)
heat_gene_df <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Heat_genes.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Filter and clean merged data
merged_filtered <- merged %>% filter(Gene %in% heat_gene_df$Gene)
merged_filtered <- merged_filtered[!is.na(merged_filtered$Gene), ]
merged_filtered <- merged_filtered[!is.na(merged_filtered[[1]]), ]

# Set rownames as gene names (in file order and unique if repeated)
rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(heat_gene_df$Gene_name[match(merged_filtered$Gene, heat_gene_df$Gene)])

# Proceed with matrix extraction, annotation, etc.

log2fc_cols <- grep("^log2FC_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
padj_cols   <- grep("^padj_",   colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
log2fc_mat  <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, log2fc_cols])
padj_mat    <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, padj_cols])
numbers_to_display <- ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05 & !is.na(log2fc_mat), round(log2fc_mat, 2), "")

# Relabel columns for clarity and build annotation data frame
treatment_labels <- gsub("^log2FC_", "", colnames(log2fc_mat))
treatment_labels <- gsub("sym", "Symbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("apo", "Aposymbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("Hnit", "Heat+Nitrate", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("heat", "Heat", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("nit", "Nitrate", treatment_labels)
colnames(log2fc_mat) <- treatment_labels
colnames(numbers_to_display) <- treatment_labels

col_ann <- data.frame(
  state = ifelse(grepl("^Aposymbiotic", colnames(log2fc_mat)), "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"),
  Treatment = gsub(".*_(.*)$", "\\1", colnames(log2fc_mat)),
  row.names = colnames(log2fc_mat)
)
col_ann$Treatment[col_ann$Treatment == "Nit"] <- "Nitrate"

# Define annotation colors
ann_colors <- list(
  state = c(Symbiotic = "#8B4513", Aposymbiotic = "gray40"),
  Treatment = c(Nitrate = "#556B2F", Heat = "coral1", `Heat+Nitrate` = "#D65278")
)

# Order columns: Aposymbiotic first, then Symbiotic; within each, Nit, Heat, Heat+Nit
desired_treatment_order <- c("Nitrate", "Heat", "Heat+Nitrate")

ordered_idx <- order(
  factor(col_ann$state, levels = c("Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic")),
  factor(col_ann$Treatment, levels = desired_treatment_order)
)
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, ordered_idx]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, ordered_idx]
col_ann <- col_ann[ordered_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Heatmap color scale and breaks
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100)
breaks <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 101)

# Remove columns named NA or that are all NA (just in case)
keep_cols <- !is.na(colnames(log2fc_mat)) & colnames(log2fc_mat) != "" & !apply(log2fc_mat, 2, function(x) all(is.na(x)))
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, keep_cols]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, keep_cols]
col_ann <- col_ann[keep_cols, , drop = FALSE]
# Assign gene names (or gene IDs) as rownames if you haven't already
if ("Gene_name" %in% colnames(merged_filtered)) {
  rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(merged_filtered$Gene_name)
} else {
  rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(merged_filtered$Gene)
}
write.csv(merged_filtered, file = "log2fc_mat.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Plot with gene_name shown on y-axis
pdf("heat_stress_heatmap.pdf",height = 1.8, width = 3.9)
pheatmap(
  log2fc_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  color = rev(col),
  breaks = breaks,
  na_col = "white",
  display_numbers = numbers_to_display,
 fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  fontsize_number = 4,
  number_color = "white",
  annotation_col = col_ann,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  labels_col = NA,
  border_color      = "black"
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
dfs <- lapply(seq_along(file_names), function(i) {
  df <- read.delim(file_names[i], header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[, c("Gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")]
  colnames(df)[2:3] <- paste0(c("log2FC_", "padj_"), treatment_names[i])
  df
})
merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "Gene"), dfs)
gene_list <- read.csv("~/Desktop/GO_0000302_genes_v1.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

genes <- c(
  "GPX1", "PRDX5", "SODC","SODM", "PARK7", "TRX1", "TRXR2","ROMO1"
)

ros<-subset(gene_list, Gene_name %in% genes)

# Filter and clean merged data
merged_filtered <- merged %>% filter(Gene %in% ros$Gene)

# Remove rows where Gene is NA (sometimes introduced by unmatched genes)
merged_filtered <- merged_filtered[!is.na(merged_filtered$Gene), ]

# Assign gene names as rownames, making sure there are no duplicates
rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(ros$Gene_name[match(merged_filtered$Gene, ros$Gene)])


# Extract log2FC and padj matrices
log2fc_cols <- grep("^log2FC_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
padj_cols <- grep("^padj_", colnames(merged_filtered), value = TRUE)
log2fc_mat <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, log2fc_cols])
padj_mat   <- as.matrix(merged_filtered[, padj_cols])

# Matrix for display: numbers only for padj < 0.05
numbers_to_display <- ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05 & !is.na(log2fc_mat), round(log2fc_mat, 2), "")

# Relabel columns for clarity and build annotation data frame
treatment_labels <- gsub("^log2FC_", "", colnames(log2fc_mat))
treatment_labels <- gsub("sym", "Symbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("apo", "Aposymbiotic_", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("Hnit", "Heat+Nitrate", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("heat", "Heat", treatment_labels)
treatment_labels <- gsub("nit", "Nitrate", treatment_labels)
colnames(log2fc_mat) <- treatment_labels
colnames(numbers_to_display) <- treatment_labels

col_ann <- data.frame(
  state = ifelse(grepl("^Aposymbiotic", colnames(log2fc_mat)), "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"),
  Treatment = gsub(".*_(.*)$", "\\1", colnames(log2fc_mat)),
  row.names = colnames(log2fc_mat)
)
col_ann$Treatment[col_ann$Treatment == "Nit"] <- "Nitrate"

# Define annotation colors
ann_colors <- list(
  state = c(Symbiotic = "#8B4513", Aposymbiotic = "gray40"),
  Treatment = c(Nitrate = "#556B2F", Heat = "coral1", `Heat+Nitrate` = "#D65278")
)

# Order columns: Aposymbiotic first, then Symbiotic; within each, Nit, Heat, Heat+Nit
desired_treatment_order <- c("Nitrate", "Heat", "Heat+Nitrate")

ordered_idx <- order(
  factor(col_ann$state, levels = c("Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic")),
  factor(col_ann$Treatment, levels = desired_treatment_order)
)
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, ordered_idx]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, ordered_idx]
col_ann <- col_ann[ordered_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Heatmap color scale and breaks
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))(100)
breaks <- seq(-1.5, 1.5, length.out = 101)

# Remove columns named NA or that are all NA (just in case)
keep_cols <- !is.na(colnames(log2fc_mat)) & colnames(log2fc_mat) != "" & !apply(log2fc_mat, 2, function(x) all(is.na(x)))
log2fc_mat <- log2fc_mat[, keep_cols]
numbers_to_display <- numbers_to_display[, keep_cols]
col_ann <- col_ann[keep_cols, , drop = FALSE]
# Assign gene names (or gene IDs) as rownames if you haven't already
if ("Gene_name" %in% colnames(merged_filtered)) {
  rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(merged_filtered$Gene_name)
} else {
  rownames(merged_filtered) <- make.unique(merged_filtered$Gene)
}

# Plot with gene_name shown on y-axis
pdf("ROS_stress_heatmap.pdf",height = 2, width = 3.9)
pheatmap(
  log2fc_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  color = rev(col),
  breaks = breaks,
  na_col = "white",
  display_numbers = numbers_to_display,
 fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  fontsize_number = 4,
  number_color = "white",
  annotation_col = col_ann,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  labels_col = NA,
  border_color      = "black"
)
dev.off()
```
